title: Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 4
author: Java Team
imageAltText: Noor holding a Black Stained Glass Pane in their left hand, sitting on a Poplar Log in a Dappled Forest while waiting for a Smoker to cook food

blocks.source_text: Happy Snapshot Tues... Thursday? Yes, you read that right! As we've entered peak vacation season here in Sweden, snapshots might not come out on their usual schedule.
blocks.translated_text: 快乐的小 snapshot 时光……每周二到周四？没错，你没看错！由于瑞典正处于度假高峰期，小 snapshot 的发布时间可能会与往常不同。

blocks.source_text: In today's snapshot we have switched the library used for window management, input and platform integration from GLFW to SDL3.
blocks.translated_text: 在今天的小 snapshot 中，我们更换了用于窗口管理、输入和平台集成的库，从 GLFW 更换为 SDL3。」

blocks.source_text: We have also added new item components for custom furnace fuels, as well as several technical changes for signs, world generation and loot tables.
blocks.translated_text: 我们还为自定义熔炉燃料添加了新的物品组件，并对标志、世界生成和战利品表进行了一些技术性修改。

blocks.source_text: Happy mining!
blocks.translated_text: 采矿愉快！

blocks.source_text: Known Issues
blocks.translated_text: 已知问题

blocks.source_text: Exclusive fullscreen mode on Windows may cause the game to crash in certain situations, especially when using multiple monitors
blocks.translated_text: 在 Windows 上，全屏模式在某些情况下可能会导致游戏崩溃，尤其是在使用多个显示器时

blocks.source_text: Entering Exclusive fullscreen mode crashes the game on Wayland
blocks.translated_text: 在 Wayland 上，进入全屏模式会导致游戏崩溃

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新功能

blocks.source_text: Players in spectator mode can now interact with portals to teleport
blocks.translated_text: 现在，处于观众模式的玩家也可以与传送门交互进行传送。

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 变更

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体的小调整

blocks.source_text: Armadillos no longer try to roll up when submerged in liquids
blocks.translated_text: 犰狳不再试图在浸入液体中时滚动

blocks.source_text: UI
blocks.translated_text: 用户界面

blocks.source_text: Removed the Raw Input mouse setting
blocks.translated_text: 移除了“原始输入”鼠标设置

blocks.source_text: Mouse input now always uses relative mouse mode while playing in-game
blocks.translated_text: 在游戏中玩的时候，鼠标输入现在始终使用相对鼠标模式

blocks.source_text: Key bindings now use physical keys instead of keyboard-layout-specific key codes
blocks.translated_text: 键绑定现在使用物理按键，而不是特定于键盘布局的键码

blocks.source_text: Borderless Fullscreen is now the default fullscreen mode
blocks.translated_text: 无边框全屏现在是默认的全屏模式

blocks.source_text: Switching between Borderless and Exclusive Fullscreen no longer requires restarting the game
blocks.translated_text: 在无边框全屏和独占全屏模式之间切换不再需要重启游戏

blocks.source_text: Exclusive fullscreen mode on macOS is no longer supported
blocks.translated_text: macOS 上的独占全屏模式不再受支持

blocks.source_text: The minimum window size is now 320 by 240 pixels
blocks.translated_text: 最小窗口大小现在为320 x 240像素

blocks.source_text: On macOS, holding a key while entering text now displays the native accent and candidate popup
blocks.translated_text: 在macOS上，输入文本时按住某个键会显示原生提示字符和候选内容弹窗

blocks.source_text: On Linux systems, the game will now use and prefer Wayland natively if available
blocks.translated_text: 在Linux系统上，如果可用的话，游戏将优先使用Wayland竺理

blocks.source_text: Debug Overlay
blocks.translated_text: 调试覆盖层

blocks.source_text: The debug overlay now supports a separate GUI scale than the rest of the game
blocks.translated_text: 调试覆盖层现在支持与游戏其他部分不同的GUI缩放比例

blocks.source_text: This is customizable through the Debug Options screen, F3 + F6
blocks.translated_text: 这可以通过“调试选项”界面（F3 + F6）进行自定义

blocks.source_text: The default scale is "Auto", which tries to stay at a higher resolution than normal
blocks.translated_text: 默认缩放设置为“自动”，该设置会尝试保持比普通模式更高的分辨率

blocks.source_text: Another option is "Unchanged", which matches your regular GUI scale
blocks.translated_text: 另一个选项是“不变”，它与你常规的GUI缩放比例相同

blocks.source_text: The rest of the options work the same as in the normal "GUI Scale", controlling the scale directly
blocks.translated_text: 其他选项的用法与常规的“GUI缩放”设置相同，可以直接控制缩放比例

blocks.source_text: Added a "player_speed" debug entry that displays the speed of the player in blocks per tick.
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个“player_speed”调试选项，可以显示玩家每刻移动的块数

blocks.source_text: The debug overlay now shows the display refresh rate
blocks.translated_text: 调试界面现在显示显示刷新率

blocks.source_text: Creative Inventory
blocks.translated_text: 创意模式下的物品栏

blocks.source_text: Reordered mineral item and block ordering to have non-tiered ingredients up first, then tiered ingredients that craft into equipment last
blocks.translated_text: 重新排列了矿物物品和方块的顺序，将非分层的材料放在前面，然后将可制作成装备的分层材料放在后面

blocks.source_text: Ingredients
blocks.translated_text: 材料

blocks.source_text: Non-tiered minerals
blocks.translated_text: 非分层矿物

blocks.source_text: Unrefined tiered minerals
blocks.translated_text: 未提纯的分层矿物

blocks.source_text: Refined tiered minerals
blocks.translated_text: 提纯的分层矿物

blocks.source_text: Nuggets
blocks.translated_text: 矿块

blocks.source_text: Ingots
blocks.translated_text: 锭块

blocks.source_text: Building Blocks
blocks.translated_text: 建筑模块

blocks.source_text: Non-tiered mineral blocks and variants
blocks.translated_text: 非层级矿物方块及其变体

blocks.source_text: Refined tiered mineral blocks and variants
blocks.translated_text: 精炼层级矿物方块及其变体

blocks.source_text: Copper block family
blocks.translated_text: 铜块系列

blocks.source_text: Copper Blocks continue to be pushed to the end of the order in Building Blocks since they have a large list of content
blocks.translated_text: 由于铜块包含大量相关内容，在“建筑块”列表中，它们的位置仍然被排在较靠后的位置

blocks.source_text: Improved ordering of Natural Blocks tab so that all inner ordering of group content sequentially progresses from Overworld -> Nether -> End to stay consistent with other tabs
blocks.translated_text: 改进了“自然方块”标签的排序方式，使得该标签下的所有内容依次按照从“上界”→“下界”→“末地”的顺序排列，以与其他标签保持一致

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术改进

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 111.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现在为 111.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 92.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现在为 92.0

blocks.source_text: Loot table types that have a dedicated registry now support registry element and tag references
blocks.translated_text: 具有专用注册表的补给箱类型现在支持注册表元素和标签引用

blocks.source_text: This means that the majority of fields of such types that previously accepted single elements will now accept either a namespaced ID or an inline value, while fields that previously accepted lists can now accept an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID
blocks.translated_text: 这意味着，之前只接受单个元素的此类字段现在可以接受命名空间ID或内联值；而之前只接受列表的字段现在可以接受内联值、单个命名空间ID、命名空间ID的列表、内联值的列表或带有前缀`#`的标签ID

blocks.source_text: Affected types:
blocks.translated_text: 受影响的类型：

blocks.source_text: minecraft:advancement
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:advancement

blocks.source_text: minecraft:item_modifier
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:item_modifier

blocks.source_text: minecraft:loot_table
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:loot_table

blocks.source_text: minecraft:number_provider
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:number_provider

blocks.source_text: minecraft:predicate
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:predicate

blocks.source_text: minecraft:recipe
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:recipe

blocks.source_text: minecraft:slot_source
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:slot_source

blocks.source_text: Existing reference types for predicates, item modifiers and slot sources are now obsolete and have been removed
blocks.translated_text: 现有的谓词（predicate）、物品修改器（item modifier）和插槽源（slot source）引用类型现已过时，已被移除

blocks.source_text: Windowing and Input Backend
blocks.translated_text: 窗口管理和输入后端

blocks.source_text: Minecraft now uses SDL3 instead of GLFW for window management, input and platform integration
blocks.translated_text: Minecraft现在使用SDL3代替GLFW来管理窗口、处理输入以及进行平台集成

blocks.source_text: Keyboard input now uses SDL scancodes for physical key positions and SDL keycodes for layout-dependent text editing shortcuts
blocks.translated_text: 键盘输入现在使用SDL扫描码来检测物理按键的位置，使用SDL按键码来执行与布局相关的文本编辑快捷键

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 111.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本111.0

blocks.source_text: Signs no longer automatically execute click events in custom text
blocks.translated_text: 自定义文本中的标志不会再自动触发点击事件

blocks.source_text: Commands
blocks.translated_text: 命令

blocks.source_text: Changes to spreadplayers
blocks.translated_text: 对`spreadplayers`功能进行了修改

blocks.source_text: Whether a block is safe to spread a player to is now controlled by the #entities_can_teleport_to block tag
blocks.translated_text: 现在是否可以将玩家传送到某个区块，由`#entities_can_teleport_to`标签控制

blocks.source_text: Environment Attributes
blocks.translated_text: 环境属性

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:gameplay/natural_mob_spawns
blocks.translated_text: 新增了`minecraft:gameplay/natural_mob_spawns`文件

blocks.source_text: Defines mob spawns in an Environment Attribute Source
blocks.translated_text: 定义实体在环境属性源中的生成规则

blocks.source_text: During worldgen placement, only Dimensions and Biomes will apply this Environment Attribute
blocks.translated_text: 在世界生成过程中，只有维度（Dimensions）和生物群系（Biomes）会应用这个环境属性

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的对象

blocks.source_text: spawns_by_category - map of spawn category to weighted list of spawn data
blocks.translated_text: spawns_by_category - 生成类别到生成数据权重列表的映射

blocks.source_text: Spawn data format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 生成数据格式：包含字段的对象

blocks.source_text: type - entity type, the entity to spawn
blocks.translated_text: type - 实体类型，即要生成的实体

blocks.source_text: count - int provider, amount to spawn
blocks.translated_text: count - 整数类型，表示生成的数量

blocks.source_text: spawn_costs - map of entity type to object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: spawn_costs - 实体类型到包含字段的对象的映射

blocks.source_text: energy_budget - float, energy change allowed per spawn
blocks.translated_text: energy_budget - 浮点数，每次生成允许的能量变化量

blocks.source_text: charge - float, how much existing mobs will attract or repulse other charged mobs
blocks.translated_text: charge - 浮点数，表示现有实体的电荷如何吸引或排斥其他带电的实体

blocks.source_text: Available attribute modifiers:
blocks.translated_text: 可用的属性修饰符：

blocks.source_text: overlay
blocks.translated_text: 覆盖层

blocks.source_text: For each mob category, overrides the lower layer's spawn settings with the higher layer's, unless the category is not included
blocks.translated_text: 对于每个怪物类别，会用较高层的生成设置覆盖较低层的生成设置，除非该类别未被包含

blocks.source_text: Merges each layer's spawn costs together, overriding the lower layer's spawn costs with the higher layer's if both define the same entity type
blocks.translated_text: 将各层的生成成本合并；如果两个层都定义了相同的实体类型，则用较高层的生成成本覆盖较低层的生成成本

blocks.source_text: Default: Empty
blocks.translated_text: 默认值：空

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:gameplay/creature_world_gen_spawn_probability
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 minecraft:gameplay/creature_world_gen Spawn_probability 文件

blocks.source_text: Sets the probability to run an iteration in which mobs defined to spawn in the creature mob category will spawn during world generation
blocks.translated_text: 设置在世界生成过程中，属于该怪物类别的怪物有生成的概率

blocks.source_text: Only Dimensions and Biomes will apply this Environment Attribute
blocks.translated_text: 只有维度（Dimensions）和生物群系（Biomes）会应用此环境属性

blocks.source_text: Format: float with range [0,1)
blocks.translated_text: 格式：范围在 [0,1] 之间的浮点数

blocks.source_text: Default: 0.1
blocks.translated_text: 默认值：0.1

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:visual/ambient_particles
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:visual/ambient_particles

blocks.source_text: Now supports interpolation between Timeline keyframes (probabilities will be crossfaded)
blocks.translated_text: 现在支持在时间轴关键帧之间进行插值（概率会逐渐过渡）

blocks.source_text: Introduced support for new modifier: append
blocks.translated_text: 引入了新的修改器：append

blocks.source_text: Unlike override which totally replaces the particle list, this modifier concatenates all elements with the layers below
blocks.translated_text: 与完全替换粒子列表的 override 不同，这个修改器会将与下方层次的所有元素连接在一起

blocks.source_text: Data Components
blocks.translated_text: 数据组件(Data Components)

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:cooking_fuel
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 minecraft:cooking_fuel

blocks.source_text: Describes an item that can be used as fuel for a Furnace, Smoker or Blast Furnace
blocks.translated_text: 描述了一种可以用作熔炉、抽烟机或高炉燃料的物品

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的对象

blocks.source_text: burn_time - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the time, in ticks, for which this fuel will burn
blocks.translated_text: burn_time - 带有命名空间的 ID，指向 minecraft:number_provider 注册表中的一个元素，表示该燃料可以燃烧的时间（以游戏刻为单位）

blocks.source_text: speed_multiplier - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the speed of the cooking/smelting
blocks.translated_text: `speed_multiplier` - 带命名空间的 ID，指向 `minecraft:number_provider` 注册表中的一个元素，该元素表示烹饪/熔化的速度

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:brewing_fuel
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `minecraft:brewing_fuel`

blocks.source_text: Describes an item that can be used as fuel for a Brewing Stand
blocks.translated_text: 描述了一种可用作酿造台燃料的物品

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields
blocks.translated_text: 格式：带有字段的对象

blocks.source_text: uses - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the number of times this fuel will brew before being consumed
blocks.translated_text: `uses` - 带命名空间的 ID，指向 `minecraft:number_provider` 注册表中的一个元素，该元素表示这种燃料在消耗前可以用于酿造的次数

blocks.source_text: speed_multiplier - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the speed of the brewing
blocks.translated_text: `speed_multiplier` - 带命名空间的 ID，指向 `minecraft:number_provider` 注册表中的一个元素，该元素表示酿造的速度

blocks.source_text: Note: the #brewing_fuel item tag has been removed and will no longer function to register new brewing fuels
blocks.translated_text: 注意：`#brewing_fuel` 物品标签已被移除，因此将不能再用于注册新的酿造燃料

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:sign_text_front and minecraft:sign_text_back
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `minecraft:sign_text_front` 和 `minecraft:sign_text_back`

blocks.source_text: Two identical components that represent text in front and back of a sign
blocks.translated_text: 两个相同的组件，分别用于在标志前后的文本显示

blocks.source_text: Contents will be displayed in item tooltip
blocks.translated_text: 内容将会显示在物品的提示框中

blocks.source_text: The format is the same as front_text and back_text fields on minecraft:sign and minecraft:hanging_sign block entities, i.e.
blocks.translated_text: 该格式与 minecraft:sign 和 minecraft:hanging_sign 块实体的 front_text 与 back_text 字段相同

blocks.source_text: messages - a list of text components
blocks.translated_text: messages - 用于存储文本组件的列表

blocks.source_text: filtered_messages - an optional list of text components, if omitted, it will be set to the same value as messages
blocks.translated_text: filtered_messages - 用于存储筛选后的文本组件的列表；如果省略，则其值将与 messages 相同

blocks.source_text: messages and filtered_messages must have same entry count
blocks.translated_text: messages 和 filtered_messages 的条目数量必须相同

blocks.source_text: color - optional dye color, default: black
blocks.translated_text: color - 可选的染料颜色，默认为黑色

blocks.source_text: has_glowing_text - optional boolean, default: false
blocks.translated_text: has_glowing_text - 可选的布尔值，默认为 false

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:waxed
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 minecraft:waxed 块类型

blocks.source_text: A marker for blocks with contents that are waxed
blocks.translated_text: 用于标记被涂抹了蜡的块的标识符

blocks.source_text: No fields
blocks.translated_text: 无字段

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:cushion/color
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 minecraft:cushion/color

blocks.source_text: Applied to Cushion entities when they get placed using an item
blocks.translated_text: 当使用物品放置 Cushion 实体时，会应用该颜色

blocks.source_text: Format: one of 16 dye colors
blocks.translated_text: 格式：16种染料颜色中的一种

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:villager_food
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 minecraft:villager_food

blocks.source_text: Represents items that Villagers can eat. Villagers will pick up items with this component in addition to items in the #villager_picks_up tag.
blocks.translated_text: 表示村民可以吃的物品。村民会拾取带有此组件的物品，以及带有 #villager_picks_up 标签的物品

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含多个字段的对象

blocks.source_text: nutrition - positive integer, how much hunger the item satiates in the Villager once eaten
blocks.translated_text: 营养值 - 正整数，表示该物品被村民食用后能满足的饥饿程度

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:mob_visibility
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 minecraft:mob_visibility

blocks.source_text: Represents the visibility percentage provided by an item with the appropriate minecraft:equippable component, modifying the range at which mobs are able to detect an entity
blocks.translated_text: 表示带有相应 minecraft:equippable 组件的物品所提供的可见度百分比，该百分比会影响怪物能够检测到实体的范围

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的对象

blocks.source_text: targeting_entity - an entity ID, a list of namespaced entity IDs, or a hash-prefixed entity tag to match
blocks.translated_text: targeting_entity - 实体 ID、命名空间实体 ID 的列表，或带有前缀的实体标签用于匹配

blocks.source_text: visibility - float (between 0.0 and 10.0), with 0.0 reducing the range at which mobs detects the entity to 2 blocks while 10.0 increases the detection range tenfold
blocks.translated_text: 可见性（visibility） - 浮点数（范围在 0.0 到 10.0 之间）：0.0 会将怪物检测实体的范围缩小到 2 个方块；10.0 会将检测范围扩大 10 倍

blocks.source_text: While multiple items with this component stack, the maximum vision will still never exceed 10.0
blocks.translated_text: 即使堆叠了多个具有此组件的物品，最大视野值也不会超过 10.0

blocks.source_text: Block Entity Data
blocks.translated_text: 方块实体数据（Block Entity Data）

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:sign and minecraft:hanging_sign
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:sign 和 minecraft:hanging_sign 的设计

blocks.source_text: By default, commands and other click events contained in Sign text are no longer executed when the block is clicked
blocks.translated_text: 默认情况下，点击方块时不再执行签名（Sign）文本中的命令和其他点击事件

blocks.source_text: Additionally, text components on newly placed Signs are no longer resolved by default
blocks.translated_text: 此外，新放置的签名上的文本组件默认也不会被解析

blocks.source_text: New boolean field called allow_op_features (defaults to false ) has been added to restore previous behavior
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个名为 `allow_op_features` 的布尔字段（默认值为 `false`），用于恢复之前的行为

blocks.source_text: Placed Signs and items with the minecraft:block_entity_data component containing Sign data stored in worlds saved before this version will have allow_op_features set to true
blocks.translated_text: 在此版本之前保存的世界中，带有 `minecraft:block_entity_data` 组件的放置标志（Placed Signs）和物品将会自动将 `allow_op_features` 设置为 `true`

blocks.source_text: Any newly created Sign will need to have that field set explicitly
blocks.translated_text: 任何新创建的标志都需要手动设置该字段

blocks.source_text: Changed the rules for opening the Sign edit screen after a block is placed:
blocks.translated_text: 更改了放置方块后打开标志编辑界面的规则。

blocks.source_text: Previously, the screen would open unless minecraft:block_entity_data was applied successfully
blocks.translated_text: 之前，只要成功应用了 `minecraft:block_entity_data`，编辑界面就会自动打开

blocks.source_text: Now, the screen will open only if it could be opened normally by clicking the block (i.e. it's not waxed and only has editable text on the front side)
blocks.translated_text: 现在，只有当标志可以正常通过点击来打开时（即没有被涂蜡，且正面只有可编辑的文本），编辑界面才会打开

blocks.source_text: Signs will now accept and return the minecraft:sign_text_front , minecraft:sign_text_back and minecraft:waxed components
blocks.translated_text: 标志现在可以接受并返回 `minecraft:sign_text_front`、`minecraft:sign_text_back` 和 `minecraft:waxed` 组件

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:brewing_stand
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:brewing_stand

blocks.source_text: The following fields are now stored as integers rather than shorts:
blocks.translated_text: 以下字段现在以整数形式存储，而不是短整型（short）：

content:
Happy Snapshot Tues... Thursday? Yes, you read that right! As we've entered peak vacation season here in Sweden, snapshots might not come out on their usual schedule.

In today's snapshot we have switched the library used for window management, input and platform integration from GLFW to SDL3.

We have also added new item components for custom furnace fuels, as well as several technical changes for signs, world generation and loot tables.

Happy mining!

Known Issues

Exclusive fullscreen mode on Windows may cause the game to crash in certain situations, especially when using multiple monitors

Entering Exclusive fullscreen mode crashes the game on Wayland

New Features

Players in spectator mode can now interact with portals to teleport

Changes

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Armadillos no longer try to roll up when submerged in liquids

UI

Removed the Raw Input mouse setting

Mouse input now always uses relative mouse mode while playing in-game

Key bindings now use physical keys instead of keyboard-layout-specific key codes

Borderless Fullscreen is now the default fullscreen mode

Switching between Borderless and Exclusive Fullscreen no longer requires restarting the game

Exclusive fullscreen mode on macOS is no longer supported

The minimum window size is now 320 by 240 pixels

On macOS, holding a key while entering text now displays the native accent and candidate popup

On Linux systems, the game will now use and prefer Wayland natively if available

Debug Overlay

The debug overlay now supports a separate GUI scale than the rest of the game

This is customizable through the Debug Options screen, F3 + F6

The default scale is "Auto", which tries to stay at a higher resolution than normal

Another option is "Unchanged", which matches your regular GUI scale

The rest of the options work the same as in the normal "GUI Scale", controlling the scale directly

Added a "player_speed" debug entry that displays the speed of the player in blocks per tick.

The debug overlay now shows the display refresh rate

Creative Inventory

Reordered mineral item and block ordering to have non-tiered ingredients up first, then tiered ingredients that craft into equipment last

Ingredients

Non-tiered minerals

Unrefined tiered minerals

Refined tiered minerals

Nuggets

Ingots

Building Blocks

Non-tiered mineral blocks and variants

Refined tiered mineral blocks and variants

Copper block family

Copper Blocks continue to be pushed to the end of the order in Building Blocks since they have a large list of content

Improved ordering of Natural Blocks tab so that all inner ordering of group content sequentially progresses from Overworld -> Nether -> End to stay consistent with other tabs

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 111.0

The Resource Pack version is now 92.0

Loot table types that have a dedicated registry now support registry element and tag references

This means that the majority of fields of such types that previously accepted single elements will now accept either a namespaced ID or an inline value, while fields that previously accepted lists can now accept an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID

Affected types:

minecraft:advancement

minecraft:item_modifier

minecraft:loot_table

minecraft:number_provider

minecraft:predicate

minecraft:recipe

minecraft:slot_source

Existing reference types for predicates, item modifiers and slot sources are now obsolete and have been removed

Windowing and Input Backend

Minecraft now uses SDL3 instead of GLFW for window management, input and platform integration

Keyboard input now uses SDL scancodes for physical key positions and SDL keycodes for layout-dependent text editing shortcuts

Data Pack Version 111.0

Signs no longer automatically execute click events in custom text

Commands

Changes to spreadplayers

Whether a block is safe to spread a player to is now controlled by the #entities_can_teleport_to block tag

Environment Attributes

Added minecraft:gameplay/natural_mob_spawns

Defines mob spawns in an Environment Attribute Source

During worldgen placement, only Dimensions and Biomes will apply this Environment Attribute

Format: object with fields:

spawns_by_category - map of spawn category to weighted list of spawn data

Spawn data format: object with fields:

type - entity type, the entity to spawn

count - int provider, amount to spawn

spawn_costs - map of entity type to object with fields:

energy_budget - float, energy change allowed per spawn

charge - float, how much existing mobs will attract or repulse other charged mobs

Available attribute modifiers:

overlay

For each mob category, overrides the lower layer's spawn settings with the higher layer's, unless the category is not included

Merges each layer's spawn costs together, overriding the lower layer's spawn costs with the higher layer's if both define the same entity type

Default: Empty

Added minecraft:gameplay/creature_world_gen_spawn_probability

Sets the probability to run an iteration in which mobs defined to spawn in the creature mob category will spawn during world generation

Only Dimensions and Biomes will apply this Environment Attribute

Format: float with range [0,1)

Default: 0.1

Changed minecraft:visual/ambient_particles

Now supports interpolation between Timeline keyframes (probabilities will be crossfaded)

Introduced support for new modifier: append

Unlike override which totally replaces the particle list, this modifier concatenates all elements with the layers below

Data Components

Added minecraft:cooking_fuel

Describes an item that can be used as fuel for a Furnace, Smoker or Blast Furnace

Format: object with fields

burn_time - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the time, in ticks, for which this fuel will burn

speed_multiplier - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the speed of the cooking/smelting

Added minecraft:brewing_fuel

Describes an item that can be used as fuel for a Brewing Stand

Format: object with fields

uses - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the number of times this fuel will brew before being consumed

speed_multiplier - namespaced ID pointing to an element of minecraft:number_provider registry representing the speed of the brewing

Note: the #brewing_fuel item tag has been removed and will no longer function to register new brewing fuels

Added minecraft:sign_text_front and minecraft:sign_text_back

Two identical components that represent text in front and back of a sign

Contents will be displayed in item tooltip

The format is the same as front_text and back_text fields on minecraft:sign and minecraft:hanging_sign block entities, i.e.

messages - a list of text components

filtered_messages - an optional list of text components, if omitted, it will be set to the same value as messages

messages and filtered_messages must have same entry count

color - optional dye color, default: black

has_glowing_text - optional boolean, default: false

Added minecraft:waxed

A marker for blocks with contents that are waxed

No fields

Added minecraft:cushion/color

Applied to Cushion entities when they get placed using an item

Format: one of 16 dye colors

Added minecraft:villager_food

Represents items that Villagers can eat. Villagers will pick up items with this component in addition to items in the #villager_picks_up tag.

Format: object with fields

nutrition - positive integer, how much hunger the item satiates in the Villager once eaten

Added minecraft:mob_visibility

Represents the visibility percentage provided by an item with the appropriate minecraft:equippable component, modifying the range at which mobs are able to detect an entity

Format: object with fields

targeting_entity - an entity ID, a list of namespaced entity IDs, or a hash-prefixed entity tag to match

visibility - float (between 0.0 and 10.0), with 0.0 reducing the range at which mobs detects the entity to 2 blocks while 10.0 increases the detection range tenfold

While multiple items with this component stack, the maximum vision will still never exceed 10.0

Block Entity Data

Changed minecraft:sign and minecraft:hanging_sign

By default, commands and other click events contained in Sign text are no longer executed when the block is clicked

Additionally, text components on newly placed Signs are no longer resolved by default

New boolean field called allow_op_features (defaults to false ) has been added to restore previous behavior

Placed Signs and items with the minecraft:block_entity_data component containing Sign data stored in worlds saved before this version will have allow_op_features set to true

Any newly created Sign will need to have that field set explicitly

Changed the rules for opening the Sign edit screen after a block is placed:

Previously, the screen would open unless minecraft:block_entity_data was applied successfully

Now, the screen will open only if it could be opened normally by clicking the block (i.e. it's not waxed and only has editable text on the front side)

Signs will now accept and return the minecraft:sign_text_front , minecraft:sign_text_back and minecraft:waxed components

Changed minecraft:brewing_stand

The following fields are now stored as integers rather than shorts:

Changed the BrewTime field from a short to an integer, this is the amount of time that the current brewing process has taken so far

Changed the Fuel field from a byte to an integer, this is the amount of fuel remaining

The following new fields have been added:

Added the total_brew_time integer field, this is the total amount of time the current brewing process will take

Added the total_fuel integer field, this represents the amount of fuel that was added in the last refuel

Added the speed_multiplier float field, this will be used to speed up or slow down the next brewing process

Changed minecraft:furnace, minecraft:smoker and minecraft:blast_furnace

The following fields are now stored as integers rather than shorts:

Changed the cooking_time_spent field from a short to an integer, this is the amount of time that the current cooking process has taken so far

Changed the cooking_total_time field from a short to an integer, this is the total amount of time the current cooking process will take

Changed the lit_time_remaining field from a short to an integer, this is the amount of burn time remaining

Changed the lit_total_time field from a short to an integer, this is the total amount of burn time that was added in the last refuel

The following new fields have been added:

Added the speed_multiplier float field, this will be used to speed up or slow down the next brewing process

Rewards

The loot sub-field in the rewards field now accepts an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:loot_table type

Triggers

Multiple fields that accepted a list of loot conditions are now stricter:

Previous functionality of a list of conditions was equivalent to a single minecraft:all_of condition has been removed

Additionally, type field is mandatory (previously it defaulted to minecraft:entity_properties )

Some fields that previously accepted only inline loot conditions now also accept a namespaced ID of a minecraft:predicate

The player field, available on all triggers except minecraft:impossible , now accepts an inline value or a namespaced ID of a minecraft:predicate type

Performs (unclamped) linear interpolation between two arguments based on an alpha. Format: object with fields:

快乐的小 snapshot 时光……每周二到周四？没错，你没看错！由于瑞典正处于度假高峰期，小 snapshot 的发布时间可能会与往常不同。

在今天的小 snapshot 中，我们更换了用于窗口管理、输入和平台集成的库，从 GLFW 更换为 SDL3。」

我们还为自定义熔炉燃料添加了新的物品组件，并对标志、世界生成和战利品表进行了一些技术性修改。

采矿愉快！

已知问题

在 Windows 上，全屏模式在某些情况下可能会导致游戏崩溃，尤其是在使用多个显示器时

在 Wayland 上，进入全屏模式会导致游戏崩溃

新功能

现在，处于观众模式的玩家也可以与传送门交互进行传送。

变更

对方块、物品和实体的小调整

犰狳不再试图在浸入液体中时滚动

用户界面

移除了“原始输入”鼠标设置

在游戏中玩的时候，鼠标输入现在始终使用相对鼠标模式

键绑定现在使用物理按键，而不是特定于键盘布局的键码

无边框全屏现在是默认的全屏模式

在无边框全屏和独占全屏模式之间切换不再需要重启游戏

macOS 上的独占全屏模式不再受支持

最小窗口大小现在为320 x 240像素

在macOS上，输入文本时按住某个键会显示原生提示字符和候选内容弹窗

在Linux系统上，如果可用的话，游戏将优先使用Wayland竺理

调试覆盖层

调试覆盖层现在支持与游戏其他部分不同的GUI缩放比例

这可以通过“调试选项”界面（F3 + F6）进行自定义

默认缩放设置为“自动”，该设置会尝试保持比普通模式更高的分辨率

另一个选项是“不变”，它与你常规的GUI缩放比例相同

其他选项的用法与常规的“GUI缩放”设置相同，可以直接控制缩放比例

新增了一个“player_speed”调试选项，可以显示玩家每刻移动的块数

调试界面现在显示显示刷新率

创意模式下的物品栏

重新排列了矿物物品和方块的顺序，将非分层的材料放在前面，然后将可制作成装备的分层材料放在后面

材料

非分层矿物

未提纯的分层矿物

提纯的分层矿物

矿块

锭块

建筑模块

非层级矿物方块及其变体

精炼层级矿物方块及其变体

铜块系列

由于铜块包含大量相关内容，在“建筑块”列表中，它们的位置仍然被排在较靠后的位置

改进了“自然方块”标签的排序方式，使得该标签下的所有内容依次按照从“上界”→“下界”→“末地”的顺序排列，以与其他标签保持一致

技术改进

数据包的版本现在为 111.0

资源包的版本现在为 92.0

具有专用注册表的补给箱类型现在支持注册表元素和标签引用

这意味着，之前只接受单个元素的此类字段现在可以接受命名空间ID或内联值；而之前只接受列表的字段现在可以接受内联值、单个命名空间ID、命名空间ID的列表、内联值的列表或带有前缀`#`的标签ID

受影响的类型：

minecraft:advancement

minecraft:item_modifier

minecraft:loot_table

minecraft:number_provider

minecraft:predicate

minecraft:recipe

minecraft:slot_source

现有的谓词（predicate）、物品修改器（item modifier）和插槽源（slot source）引用类型现已过时，已被移除

窗口管理和输入后端

Minecraft现在使用SDL3代替GLFW来管理窗口、处理输入以及进行平台集成

键盘输入现在使用SDL扫描码来检测物理按键的位置，使用SDL按键码来执行与布局相关的文本编辑快捷键

数据包版本111.0

自定义文本中的标志不会再自动触发点击事件

命令

对`spreadplayers`功能进行了修改

现在是否可以将玩家传送到某个区块，由`#entities_can_teleport_to`标签控制

环境属性

新增了`minecraft:gameplay/natural_mob_spawns`文件

定义实体在环境属性源中的生成规则

在世界生成过程中，只有维度（Dimensions）和生物群系（Biomes）会应用这个环境属性

格式：包含字段的对象

spawns_by_category - 生成类别到生成数据权重列表的映射

生成数据格式：包含字段的对象

type - 实体类型，即要生成的实体

count - 整数类型，表示生成的数量

spawn_costs - 实体类型到包含字段的对象的映射

energy_budget - 浮点数，每次生成允许的能量变化量

charge - 浮点数，表示现有实体的电荷如何吸引或排斥其他带电的实体

可用的属性修饰符：

覆盖层

对于每个怪物类别，会用较高层的生成设置覆盖较低层的生成设置，除非该类别未被包含

将各层的生成成本合并；如果两个层都定义了相同的实体类型，则用较高层的生成成本覆盖较低层的生成成本

默认值：空

添加了 minecraft:gameplay/creature_world_gen Spawn_probability 文件

设置在世界生成过程中，属于该怪物类别的怪物有生成的概率

只有维度（Dimensions）和生物群系（Biomes）会应用此环境属性

格式：范围在 [0,1] 之间的浮点数

默认值：0.1

修改了 minecraft:visual/ambient_particles

现在支持在时间轴关键帧之间进行插值（概率会逐渐过渡）

引入了新的修改器：append

与完全替换粒子列表的 override 不同，这个修改器会将与下方层次的所有元素连接在一起
